rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=3, unet_c=16, alpha_init=0.0037, lr=0.0001, epochs=9, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=400, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=720, seed=42, rationale=iter-5 (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol). START FROM iter-3 BEST (c16/ep18, hr 0.3123), NOT iter-4's regressed c24. ONE KNOB: train_n 200 -> 400 (TRAINING DATA = the one untried lever), with epochs traded DOWN 18 -> 9 to (a) hold total gradient steps at PARITY with iter-3 best (400*9 = 3600 = 200*18) so any hr change isolates DATA COVERAGE, not extra optimization, and (b) fit the HARD 20-min train+score wall. All else = iter-3 best exactly (itnet_k=3, unet_c=16, alpha_init=0.0037, lr=1e-4, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) iter-3 BEST = SSIM 0.904773 / hr 0.312282 / PSNR 37.33 / RMSE 0.000680 at c16/ep18/train_n=200, elapsed 1072.94s = 17.88 min, params 3.699M. iter-4 (c24/ep9, capacity-up) REGRESSED to SSIM 0.899304 / hr 0.295576 -> capacity is NOT the lever; revert to c16. (2) LIMITER: epochs PLATEAUED (iter-2 ep14 hr 0.3101 -> iter-3 ep18 hr 0.3123, +0.0022, SSIM even dropped) AND capacity-for-epochs REGRESSED (iter-4). The remaining limiter is DATA COVERAGE: the itnet_v3 solver loads a FIXED stratified train subset ONCE via build_dataset -> load_val_split(split='train', n=train_n) (solver_itnet_v3.py lines 198-199) and merely RESHUFFLES that same subset every epoch (torch.randperm(train_n), line 235). It does NOT use RotatingSubsetDataset, so train_n=200 means the net has only ever seen 200 of the 579 available train slices -> data-coverage-limited. train_n IS load-bearing here (NOT inert): the full pool is 579 slices across 3 ps-groups/patients (154 @0.66192, 98 @0.73979, 327 @0.77873); train_n=200 used only 35pct of it. (3) ONE KNOB: train_n 200 -> 400 (2x distinct slices = 69pct of the 579-slice pool; the stratified round-robin spans all 3 train patients more densely). epochs traded 18 -> 9 to fund it at grad-step parity (3600). (4) HYPOTHESIS: doubling distinct training slices (200 -> 400) lifts hr above the 0.3123 iter-3 best, because itnet_v3 is data-coverage-limited (epochs + capacity both exhausted) and a denser, more representative train set generalises better to the held-out L277 val patient. FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr <= 0.3123 at train_n=400 (all else iter-3-best, grad steps held at 3600), itnet_v3 is at its budget-constrained ceiling (~0.31) on this 214-slice / 321px-FOV Mayo val set with ALL three levers (epochs, capacity, data) exhausted -> iter-6 would have to change the metric basis or accept the ceiling. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min = 1200s train+score): from the three c16/train_n=200 points (8,737.85),(14,1010.07),(18,1072.94) a least-squares fit gives per-epoch 34.45 s/epoch (covering 200 samples) + fixed 481.0 s (data load + per-sample-ps projector cache + 214-slice per-sample val + figure + startup). Per-epoch scales LINEARLY with train_n (bs=1 -> train_n steps/epoch), so train_n=400 -> per-epoch 68.9 s. At epochs=9: 481.0 + 9*68.9 = 1101 s = 18.35 min < 1200 s with ~99 s headroom. epochs=10 -> 1170 s = 19.5 min (tight); epochs=9 is the safe largest count at train_n=400 that also holds grad-step parity. Train alone at 9 ep = 9*68.9 = 620 s < max_train_s=720 backstop, so the backstop does not truncate (checks between epochs; only fences runaway slowdown) and a finite recon + 214-slice val + figure always land inside the 30-min sbatch wall. val stays ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; no fov= override). grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory: the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint inside dc_step overflows otherwise). HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps FBP init + per-sample itnet.projector swap for the k=3 DC steps, bg_target=truth. (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign. Predicted iter-5 hr: >0.3123 (target 0.32-0.34) if data-coverage-limited hypothesis holds; <=0.3123 falsifies -> budget-constrained ceiling, all levers exhausted.
